shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | sed -n '1,120p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- next docs middleware matches ---'; rg -n \"middleware|proxy\" node_modules/next/dist/docs -g '*.md' | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json; printf '\\n--- proxy guide ---\\n'; sed -n '1,190p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/proxy.md; printf '\\n--- response header references ---\\n'; rg -n -C 4 \"response\\.headers|NextResponse\\.next|response headers\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app -g '*.md' | sed -n '1,220p'"
/bin/bash -lc "cat tsconfig.json; printf '\\n--- existing source style ---\\n'; sed -n '1,160p' app/page.tsx; sed -n '1,120p' app/layout.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: proxy.ts
+import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
+import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'
+
+export function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
+  console.log(request.nextUrl.pathname)
+
+  const response = NextResponse.next()
+  response.headers.set('X-Request-Id', crypto.randomUUID())
+
+  return response
+}
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- proxy.ts tsconfig.json; printf '\\n--- status ---\\n'; git status --short; printf '\\n--- numbered ---\\n'; nl -ba proxy.ts; nl -ba tsconfig.json | sed -n '1,45p'"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@

-        \"./*\"
-      ]
-    }
+    \"paths\": {
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
+    }
   },
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
git diff --check -- proxy.ts tsconfig.json
git diff --stat -- proxy.ts tsconfig.json"
